title: File:Chiang mai pano 2010 0128.jpg
author: Takeaway
description:
Panorama of the city of Chiang Mai, part of the surrounding valley and the mountains east of the city of Chiang Mai. The photo was made from the viewpoint halfway up the road towards Wat Phrathat Doi Suthep (Thanon Thong Chai Range); the Khun Tan Range can be seen in the background behind the city.
 This  image was created with Hugin.
